ROLLSIGHT.ActiveHint: Turn off to leave this session. Waiting rolls remain available in Foundry for manual completion.
ROLLSIGHT.ExtensionHint: Receive local desktop results through the RollSight extension. Cloud reception is disabled in this mode.
ROLLSIGHT.PlayerCodeHint: Open Connect RollSight here or in the Settings sidebar to copy your code and set up physical dice.
ROLLSIGHT.ManualHint: Also fill native Manual prompts. Foundry keeps its normal controls and evaluates modifiers.
ROLLSIGHT.Fallback: Post dice when no roll is waiting
ROLLSIGHT.FallbackHint: Post plain physical dice using your current chat visibility. Start initiative, attacks and advantage in Foundry first.
ROLLSIGHT.CopyManually: Select the code and copy it manually.
ROLLSIGHT.NotLinked: This world is not linked yet. Ask your GM to open Connect RollSight and choose Set up this world.
ROLLSIGHT.CodeError: RollSight could not connect. Open Connect RollSight in the Settings sidebar and choose Reconnect to RollSight.
ROLLSIGHT.AnotherTab: Another Foundry window is receiving dice for this player. Close that window to use this one.
ROLLSIGHT.NoTabLock: This browser cannot coordinate tabs. Use only one Foundry tab per RollSight player.
ROLLSIGHT.TimedOut: RollSight paused this roll after five minutes. Choose Use this roll to resume, or complete it manually in Foundry.
ROLLSIGHT.InvalidDice: Dice were not accepted. Send whole-number values within each die’s range.
ROLLSIGHT.ChooseRoll: Choose Use this roll on the Foundry prompt that should receive your dice.
ROLLSIGHT.Waiting: RollSight is waiting for {formula}. Roll and send from the desktop app. Foundry’s manual controls remain available.
ROLLSIGHT.Paused: RollSight is not receiving dice for {formula}. Select this roll to resume.
ROLLSIGHT.NoMatch: These dice do not match the selected roll’s remaining dice. Nothing was sent to chat.
ROLLSIGHT.DeliveryError: RollSight could not apply this delivery. Check the waiting roll before sending again.
ROLLSIGHT.RequestLocal: Start your roll in Foundry, then send physical dice from the desktop app. Remote desktop roll requests are not supported.
ROLLSIGHT.ReplayHint: Open the replay; select the image to view it full size.
ROLLSIGHT.ReplayUnavailable: Replay unavailable. Open the link to try again.
ROLLSIGHT.DiceReady: Physical dice configured for every supported die in this browser.
ROLLSIGHT.DiceSetup: Some dice still use digital rolls. Open Dice Configuration and select RollSight physical dice as the default; check per-die overrides.
ROLLSIGHT.ConnectIntro: Use your own player code to send dice from the RollSight app to this Foundry world.
ROLLSIGHT.ConnectPaste: Copy this code. In the RollSight app, choose Start Session → Foundry and paste it into the player code field.
ROLLSIGHT.ConnectDiceHelp: Open Dice Configuration and choose RollSight physical dice as your default. Then start a roll in Foundry before rolling your dice.
ROLLSIGHT.ConnectStopped: Receiving dice is turned off. Enable Receive RollSight dice in Game Settings to connect.
ROLLSIGHT.ConnectExtension: This browser uses the RollSight extension. Turn off Use the browser extension in Game Settings to connect with a player code.
ROLLSIGHT.WaitingTurn: RollSight will receive dice here after the newer roll is finished.
ROLLSIGHT.ReadyToRoll: Ready for your dice. Roll and send from RollSight.
